title: Rice paddies on take-off — the frame that brought back Lieutenant Hanna
description: Dry harvested paddies in pinkish stubble run to a tree line under heavy cloud, the near ground streaked with motion. "Probably taking off from Ton Son Nhut and looking at some rice paddies." The picture set Larry talking about a pilot: "Lieutenant Hanna, he was 19 or 20. He was kind of cross eyed… he was a real good pilot. I flew with him a couple times." Hanna, he says, was in his unit, went on to another after Larry left, and was killed in 1968 at Kontum.
researchNotes: Larry's comment of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0046-c18308860.json) is mostly about a man, not the frame; the man has his own record (data/people/lt-hanna.json) and a research file. The location is his 'probably' and is entered on that basis. The comment ends with the bare name 'Sargent LaFrancois', which his son says was a separate thought and not someone in this picture; it is noted on that person's record and not here. Nothing in the frame itself fixes the place; the survey read it as taken from a moving vehicle rather than an aircraft, and the low, blurred foreground would fit either.
